title: Remote Exercise Study for Individuals With Down Syndrome
brief_summary: This pilot study aims to test whether remote delivery of the exercise intervention provides a sufficient training stimulus. This pilot study will be remote and online-only, and will have no in-person interaction, data collection or intervention. 20 Participants will participate in a 12-wk, 3hrs/wk remote exercise intervention and in a pre- and a posttest remote testing session. We will use Zoom for all testing and exercise sessions.
